_about: The subscribe-video scripts (Oct 25 - Nov 8, 2026). One entry per video: what to say, the on-screen hook and event chips (no emoji: libass can't draw color emoji), each chip's cue words (the first spoken word that matches shows it), the Facebook caption and when to post it (town time). Video 3 is a draft until Sunday Nov 1's collect fills in the week of Nov 2.
